full_judgment: 8. Against this judgment and decree of the trial court dated 06.06.2012 the plaintiff Samity filed the above mentioned First Appeal No. 267 of 2012 before the High Court Division and the vendor Nazrul Islam also filed cross objection against the said judgment and decree of the trial court. A Division Bench of the High Court 'Division heard both the first appeal and cross objection analogously and by the impugned judgment and order 'allowed the first appeal and decreed the Title Suit No. 144 of 2012 for specific performance of contract and dismissed the cross objection No. 2 of 2013 filed by the vendor Nazrul Islam by the impugned judgment and order. The High Court Division also found that the agreement for sale of the suit property to the plaintiff Samity was genuine and that the vendor Nazrul Islam received the entire consideration money from the plaintiff Samity and delivered possession of the suit property in favour of the plaintiff Samity. The High Court Division found also that the entire loan taken by the vendor Nazrul Islam from Janata Bank was repaid by the plaintiff Samity. The High Court Division made observations to the effect also that for entering into a contract for sale of the suit property the vendor did not require to obtain sale permission from lessor Housing Authority and that before executing and registering the sale deed only the vendor required to obtain permission from the lessor Housing Authority. However the High Court Division directed the plaintiff to give solatium of Tk. 20,00000/- to the vendor Nazrul Islam making observations thus;
